description: One workflow run: .factory/local/runs/<run-id>/run.json (record run). Not tracked. Written by vsdd survey through vsdd.state.runs.run_open; ended is empty while the run is live (topic run-lock). Cap 2,000 bytes.

id.description: The run's identifier, which names its directory and every step record's run field: r-<YYYYMMDD>-<HHMM>-<2 of [0-9a-z]> (the shape is runs._new_id's; the shipped checker has no pattern keyword). Required: steps_list, runs_list and flush read it, and a record without it is unsafe to path.

workflow.description: The workflow this run serves: survey, spike, discover, story, wave, verify, maintain, feature, ingest, import, release.

subject.description: The unit the run serves, empty for a whole-cycle run.

repository.description: The member repository of a hub the run writes; empty in a single layout.

cycle.description: The cycle the run belongs to; empty for _standing work.

session.description: The caller-marker session that started the run.

start.description: ISO 8601 UTC, whole seconds, ending Z.

agents.description: The agent count the run has spent.

parent.description: The parent run id of a child run; empty otherwise.

stories.description: The stories admitted to this run. Run membership is the one check every gate makes (finding P3OPS-07, P3REQ-07).

request.description: The request or question the run was given: the spike question, the change-request id, the feature request.

amendment.description: True while this run holds a specification amendment (feature route, delta stage).

ended.description: The end time, empty while the run is live. Set once; the first end time stays.
